mapper.sql: biz11_cont_corp_id AS cont_corp_id , biz10_company_id AS company_id , biz11_cont_history_id AS cont_history_id , biz11_reg_date AS reg_date , biz11_cont_corp_nm AS cont_corp_nm , biz11_cont_status_cd AS cont_status_cd , biz11_cont_status_nm AS cont_status_nm , biz11_corp_status_cd AS corp_status_cd , biz11_corp_status_nm AS corp_status_nm , biz11_tr_type AS tr_type , biz11_cont_period_cd AS cont_period_cd , biz11_cont_period_nm AS cont_period_nm , biz11_cont_date AS cont_date , biz11_start_date AS start_date , biz11_close_date AS close_date , biz11_base_fee AS base_fee , biz11_manager AS manager , biz11_manager_tel AS manager_tel , biz11_note AS note , biz11_person_id AS person_id , biz11_person_nm AS person_nm , biz11_address AS address , biz11_ceo AS ceo , biz12_fee_info_id AS fee_info_id , biz12_min_fee_yn AS min_fee_yn , biz12_manage_min_fee AS manage_min_fee , biz12_adv_min_fee AS adv_min_fee , biz12_discr_min_fee AS discr_min_fee , biz12_fee_charge_type AS fee_charge_type , biz12_fee_charge_type_nm AS fee_charge_type_nm , biz12_with_yn AS with_yn , biz12_with_fee AS with_fee , biz12_min_fee_str AS min_fee_str , biz12_with_fee_str AS with_fee_str
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ( SELECT * , f_emp_kor_nm(biz11_person_id) as biz11_person_nm , f_cdnm('ContStatusCode' , biz11_cont_status_cd , biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz11_cont_status_nm , f_cdnm('ContCorpStatusCode', biz11_corp_status_cd , biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz11_corp_status_nm , f_cdnm('ContPeriodCode' , biz11_cont_period_cd , biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz11_cont_period_nm , f_cdnm('FundFeeChargeType' , biz12_fee_charge_type, biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz12_fee_charge_type_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_min_fee_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '최저보수 없음' ELSE '운용:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_manage_min_fee,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_manage_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '자문:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_adv_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_adv_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '일임:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_discr_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_discr_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원 ' END AS biz12_min_fee_str , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_with_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '병행보수 없음' ELSE TRUNC(biz12_with_fee / 10000)||'만원' END AS biz12_with_fee_str , ( SELECT MIN(biz11_cont_date) FROM biz11_cont_history WHERE biz11_cont_corp_id = biz10_cont_corp_id ) as first_cont_date FROM biz10_cont_corp INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM biz11_cont_history LEFT OUTER JOIN biz12_fee_info ON biz12_cont_history_id = biz11_cont_history_id WHERE (biz11_cont_corp_id, biz11_reg_date) IN ( SELECT biz11_cont_corp_id, MAX(biz11_reg_date) FROM biz11_cont_history WHERE biz11_reg_date <= f_today() GROUP BY biz11_cont_corp_id ) ) biz11 ON biz11_cont_corp_id = biz10_cont_corp_id WHERE biz10_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz11_cont_status_cd LIKE #{statusCode} AND ( ( #{statusCheck} = 'true' AND biz11_cont_status_cd IN ('1','2','3') ) OR ( #{statusCheck} = 'false' ) ) ) t WHERE 1=1
AND TO_CHAR("first_cont_date",'YYYY') = #{stdYear}
AND biz11_cont_corp_id IN ( SELECT biz10_cont_corp_id FROM biz10_cont_corp INNER JOIN biz11_cont_history ON biz11_cont_corp_id = biz10_cont_corp_id WHERE biz10_company_id = #{companyId} AND UPPER(CONCAT(biz11_cont_corp_nm,biz11_tr_type,biz11_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) )
AND biz11_cont_status_cd NOT IN ('8','9') /*(8:계약종료(이관)/9:계약종료)*/ AND CAST(f_today() + #{endMonth} * interval '+1month' AS DATE) >= COALESCE(biz11_close_date,'9999-12-31'::date)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{sortType} = '2' THEN biz11_close_date ELSE biz11_cont_date END

SELECT FROM ( SELECT * , f_emp_kor_nm(biz11_person_id) as biz11_person_nm , f_cdnm('ContStatusCode' , biz11_cont_status_cd , biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz11_cont_status_nm , f_cdnm('ContCorpStatusCode', biz11_corp_status_cd , biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz11_corp_status_nm , f_cdnm('ContPeriodCode' , biz11_cont_period_cd , biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz11_cont_period_nm , f_cdnm('FundFeeChargeType' , biz12_fee_charge_type, biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) as biz12_fee_charge_type_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_min_fee_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '최저보수 없음' ELSE '운용:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_manage_min_fee,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_manage_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '자문:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_adv_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_adv_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '일임:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_discr_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_discr_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원' END AS biz12_min_fee_str , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_with_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '병행보수 없음' ELSE TRUNC(biz12_with_fee / 10000)||'만원' END AS biz12_with_fee_str FROM biz10_cont_corp INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM biz11_cont_history LEFT OUTER JOIN biz12_fee_info ON biz12_cont_history_id = biz11_cont_history_id WHERE (biz11_cont_corp_id, biz11_reg_date) IN ( SELECT biz11_cont_corp_id, MAX(biz11_reg_date) FROM biz11_cont_history WHERE biz11_reg_date <= f_today() GROUP BY biz11_cont_corp_id ) ) biz11 ON biz11_cont_corp_id = biz10_cont_corp_id WHERE biz10_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND biz10_company_id = #{companyId} ) t

SELECT FROM ( SELECT biz11_cont_history.* , biz12_fee_info.* , biz10_company_id , f_cdnm('FundFeeChargeType' , biz12_fee_charge_type, biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) AS biz12_fee_charge_type_nm , f_cdnm('ContStatusCode' , biz11_cont_status_cd, biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) AS biz11_cont_status_nm , f_cdnm('ContCorpStatusCode', biz11_corp_status_cd, biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) AS biz11_corp_status_nm , f_cdnm('ContPeriodCode' , biz11_cont_period_cd, biz10_company_id, biz11_reg_date) AS biz11_cont_period_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(biz11_person_id) AS biz11_person_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_min_fee_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '최저보수 없음' ELSE '운용:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_manage_min_fee,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_manage_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '자문:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_adv_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_adv_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '일임:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_discr_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_discr_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원' END AS biz12_min_fee_str , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_with_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '병행보수 없음' ELSE TRUNC(biz12_with_fee / 10000)||'만원' END AS biz12_with_fee_str FROM biz11_cont_history LEFT OUTER JOIN biz12_fee_info ON biz12_cont_history_id = biz11_cont_history_id INNER JOIN biz10_cont_corp ON biz10_cont_corp_id = biz11_cont_corp_id WHERE biz11_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND biz10_company_id = #{companyId} ) t ORDER BY biz11_reg_date
SELECT biz11_cont_history_id FROM biz11_cont_history WHERE 1=1 AND biz11_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz10_cont_corp WHERE biz10_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND biz10_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM biz10_cont_corp WHERE biz10_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND biz10_company_id = #{companyId}
DELETE FROM biz15_share WHERE biz15_cont_history_id IN ( SELECT biz11_cont_history_id FROM biz11_cont_history WHERE biz11_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} )

DELETE FROM biz11_cont_history WHERE biz11_cont_history_id IN #{id} AND biz11_cont_corp_id IN ( SELECT biz10_cont_corp_id FROM biz10_cont_corp WHERE biz10_company_id = #{companyId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz15_share SELECT f_create_seq() , #{contHistoryId} , biz15_share_cd , biz15_person_id , biz15_org_id , biz15_company_id FROM biz15_share WHERE biz15_cont_history_id = ( SELECT biz11_cont_history_id FROM biz11_cont_history INNER JOIN biz10_cont_corp ON biz10_cont_corp_id = biz11_cont_corp_id WHERE biz10_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} ORDER BY biz11_reg_date DESC LIMIT 1 )

INSERT INTO biz15_share SELECT f_create_seq() , #{contHistoryId} , biz15_share_cd , biz15_person_id , biz15_org_id , biz15_company_id FROM biz15_share WHERE biz15_cont_history_id = ( SELECT biz11_cont_history_id FROM biz11_cont_history INNER JOIN biz10_cont_corp ON biz10_cont_corp_id = biz11_cont_corp_id WHERE biz10_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND biz11_cont_history_id != #{contHistoryId} ORDER BY biz11_reg_date DESC LIMIT 1 )

INSERT INTO biz12_fee_info ( biz12_fee_info_id, biz12_cont_history_id, biz12_min_fee_yn, biz12_manage_min_fee, biz12_adv_min_fee , biz12_discr_min_fee, biz12_fee_charge_type, biz12_with_yn, biz12_with_fee ) VALUES ( #{f.feeInfoId}, #{contHistoryId}, #{f.minFeeYn}, #{f.manageMinFee}, #{f.advMinFee} , #{f.discrMinFee}, #{f.feeChargeType}, #{f.withYn}, #{f.withFee} )
mapper.select: SELECT biz12_fee_info_id AS fee_info_id , biz12_cont_history_id AS cont_history_id , biz12_min_fee_yn AS min_fee_yn , biz12_manage_min_fee AS manage_min_fee , biz12_adv_min_fee AS adv_min_fee , biz12_discr_min_fee AS discr_min_fee , biz12_fee_charge_type AS fee_charge_type , f_cdnm('FundFeeChargeType', biz12_fee_charge_type, #{companyId}, f_today()) AS fee_charge_type_nm , biz12_with_yn AS with_yn , biz12_with_fee AS with_fee , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_min_fee_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '최저보수 없음' ELSE '운용:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_manage_min_fee,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_manage_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '자문:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_adv_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_adv_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원/'|| '일임:'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_discr_min_fee ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(biz12_discr_min_fee / 10000) END ||'만원' END AS min_fee_str , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_with_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '병행보수 없음' ELSE TRUNC(biz12_with_fee / 10000)||'만원' END AS with_fee_str FROM biz12_fee_info WHERE biz12_fee_info_id = #{feeInfoId}

SELECT a.biz15_share_id AS share_id , a.biz15_cont_history_id AS cont_history_id , a.biz15_share_cd AS share_cd , a.biz15_person_id AS person_id , a.biz15_org_id AS org_id , a.biz15_company_id AS company_id , f_cdnm('ShareCode', biz15_share_cd, c.sys01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS share_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(biz15_person_id) AS person_nm , f_org_nm(biz15_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_nm FROM biz15_share a LEFT OUTER JOIN biz11_cont_history b ON b.biz11_cont_history_id = a.biz15_cont_history_id INNER JOIN sys01_company c ON c.sys01_company_id = a.biz15_company_id WHERE biz15_cont_history_id = #{contHistoryId} AND biz15_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY biz15_share_cd, biz15_org_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz13_with_corp ( biz13_with_corp_id, biz13_cont_corp_id, biz13_company_id, biz13_manage_type, biz13_corp_id , biz13_first_start_date, biz13_last_close_date ) VALUES ( #{withCorpId}, #{r.contCorpId}, #{companyId}, #{r.manageType}, #{r.corpId}, #{r.firstStartDate}, #{r.lastCloseDate} )

mapper.select: SELECT biz17_dual_manage_fund_id AS dual_fund_id , biz17_company_id AS company_id , biz17_cont_corp_id AS cont_corp_id , biz17_fund_cd AS fund_cd , biz17_start_date AS start_date , biz17_fund_fee AS fund_fee , biz17_fund_sub_fee AS fund_sub_fee , biz17_note AS note , biz17_position_type AS position_type , f_cdnm('FundMngPositionType' , biz17_position_type, biz17_company_id, biz17_start_date) AS position_type_nm , ( SELECT ast30_fund_nm FROM ast30_book_fund_fee INNER JOIN biz13_with_corp ON ( biz13_company_id = ast30_company_id AND biz13_corp_id = ast30_corp_id AND biz13_manage_type = '1' ) WHERE ast30_company_id = biz17_company_id AND ast30_fund_cd = biz17_fund_cd AND biz13_cont_corp_id = biz17_cont_corp_id ORDER BY ast30_hold_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS fund_nm FROM biz17_dual_manage_fund WHERE biz17_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND biz17_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY biz17_fund_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz17_dual_manage_fund ( biz17_dual_manage_fund_id, biz17_company_id, biz17_cont_corp_id, biz17_fund_cd , biz17_start_date, biz17_fund_fee, biz17_fund_sub_fee, biz17_position_type ) VALUES ( #{dualFundId}, #{companyId}, #{r.contCorpId}, #{r.fundCd}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.fundFee}, #{r.fundSubFee}, #{r.positionType} )
